definition: to make something such as time or money available to somebody or for something, especially when it requires an effort for you to do this
example: spare something/somebody, I'd love to have a break, but I can't spare the time just now.
definition_zh: 让某些东西，比如时间或金钱，无论是为某人或某事提供，尤其是当这需要你付出努力时
example_zh: 能不能给点什么/帮个忙，我很想休息一下，但现在没空。

definition: to cause something to start or develop, especially suddenly
example: spark something, The proposal would spark a storm of protest around the country.
definition_zh: 让某件事突然开始或发展，尤其是突然之间
example_zh: 引发点火，这个提案将在全国范围内引发一场抗议风暴。

definition: designed or developed for a particular purpose or area of knowledge
example: specialized equipment
definition_zh: 为特定目的或知识领域而设计或开发
example_zh: 专用设备

definition: a detailed description of how something is, or should be, designed or made
example: the technical specifications of the new model (= of car)
definition_zh: 对某物如何、应该如何设计或制造的详细描述
example_zh: 新车型的技术规格（= 车型）

definition: a small amount of something that shows what the rest of it is like
example: Astronauts have brought back specimens of rock from the moon.
definition_zh: 一小部分内容，用来展示整体情况
example_zh: 宇航员从月球带回了岩石标本。

definition: two lenses in a frame that rests on the nose and ears. People wear spectacles in order to be able to see better or to protect their eyes from bright light.
example: a pair of spectacles
definition_zh: 镜框中有两个镜片，架在鼻子和耳朵上。人们戴眼镜是为了看得更清楚或保护眼睛免受强光照射。
example_zh: 一副眼镜

definition: a band of coloured lights in order of their wavelengths, as seen in a rainbow and into which light may be separated
example: A spectrum is formed by a ray of light passing through a prism.
definition_zh: 一束按波长排列的彩色光带，如彩虹中可见的光，光线可被分成其中
example_zh: 光谱是由光线穿过棱镜形成的。

definition: a short period of time during which something lasts
example: We had a spell of warm weather in April.
definition_zh: 一段短暂的时间，在这段时间内某件事持续
example_zh: 我们四月份经历了一段温暖的天气。

definition: a solid figure that is completely round, with every point on its surface at an equal distance from the centre
example: The Earth is not a perfect sphere.
definition_zh: 一个完全圆形的实心图形，其表面上的每一点都与中心等距
example_zh: 地球并不是一个完美的球体。

definition: a very fast turning movement
example: Only in the last 50 years have we had clocks accurate enough to measure changes in the earth's spin.
definition_zh: 转弯速度非常快
example_zh: 直到过去50年，我们才有了足够精确可以测量地球自转变化的时钟。

definition: to turn round and round quickly; to make something do this
example: (+ adv./prep.), The plane was spinning out of control.
definition_zh: 快速转来转去;让某物做到这一点
example_zh: （+进度/准备），飞机失控旋转。

definition: the row of small bones that are connected together down the middle of the back
example: A shiver went down my spine.
definition_zh: 背部中间相连的小骨头排
example_zh: 一阵寒意顺着脊背蔓延。

definition: a light with a single, very bright beam that can be directed at a particular place or person, especially a performer on the stage
example: The room was lit by spotlights.
definition_zh: 一种带有单一、非常明亮光束的灯光，可以对准特定地点或人物，尤其是舞台上的表演者
example_zh: 房间里有聚光灯照亮。

definition: a husband or wife
example: Fill in your spouse’s name here.
definition_zh: 丈夫或妻子
example_zh: 请在这里填写您配偶的名字。

definition: a person who tries to get secret information about another country, organization or person, especially somebody who is employed by a government or the police
example: He was denounced as a foreign spy.
definition_zh: 试图获取关于另一个国家、组织或个人的秘密信息的人，尤其是受政府或警察雇佣的人
example_zh: 他被指控为外国间谍。

definition: to collect secret information about another country, organization or person
example: He spied for his government for more than ten years.
definition_zh: 收集关于另一个国家、组织或个人的机密信息
example_zh: 他为政府从事间谍工作超过十年。

definition: a section of a police force that deals with a particular type of crime
example: the drugs/fraud/bomb/riot squad
definition_zh: 警察部队中处理特定类型犯罪的部门
example_zh: 毒品/诈骗/爆炸/防暴小组

definition: to press something, especially with your fingers
example: to squeeze a tube of toothpaste
definition_zh: 按压某样东西，尤其是用手指
example_zh: 挤压一管牙膏

definition: to push a sharp, pointed object, especially a knife, into somebody, killing or injuring them
example: He was stabbed to death in a racist attack.
definition_zh: 将尖锐、尖锐的物体，尤其是刀子，推向某人，致死或受伤
example_zh: 他在一次种族主义袭击中被刺死。

definition: the quality or state of being steady and not changing or being upset in any way (= the quality of being stable)
example: political/economic/social stability
definition_zh: 稳定且不改变或不烦躁的品质或状态（=稳定的品质）
example_zh: 政治/经济/社会稳定

definition: to become or to make something become steady and unlikely to change; to make something stable
example: The patient's condition stabilized.
definition_zh: 成为或使某物稳定且不太可能改变;使某物稳定
example_zh: 病人的状况已经稳定下来。

definition: money that somebody invests in a company
example: a 20 per cent stake in the business
definition_zh: 某人投资于公司的资金
example_zh: 持有公司20%的股份

definition: done from a position in which you are standing rather than sitting or running
example: a standing jump/start
definition_zh: 从站立姿势进行，而不是坐着或跑步
example_zh: 站立跳跃/起步

definition: unpleasant; real, and impossible to avoid
example: The author paints a stark picture of life in a prison camp.
definition_zh: 令人不快;真实且无法回避
example_zh: 作者描绘了监狱营地生活的严峻画面。

definition: connected with or based on statistics
example: statistical analysis
definition_zh: 与统计数据相关或基于统计数据
example_zh: 统计分析

definition: to control the direction in which a boat, car, etc. moves
example: He steered the boat into the harbour.
definition_zh: 用来控制船只、汽车等车辆的运动方向
example_zh: 他把船驶入港口。

definition: the main long, thin part of a plant above the ground from which the leaves or flowers grow; a smaller part that grows from this and supports flowers or leaves
example: long, trailing stems of ivy
definition_zh: 植物表面上主要的细长部分，叶子或花朵由此生长;较小部分从中生长，支撑花朵或叶片
example_zh: 长长的常春藤枝条垂挂

definition: to stop something that is flowing from spreading or increasing
example: The cut was bandaged to stem the bleeding.
definition_zh: 阻止正在流动的物质扩散或增加
example_zh: 伤口被包扎以止血。

definition: a fixed idea or image that many people have of a particular type of person or thing, but which is often not true in reality and may cause hurt and offence
example: cultural/gender/racial stereotypes
definition_zh: 许多人对某类人或事物有固定的印象或形象，但现实中往往并不真实，可能带来伤害和冒犯
example_zh: 文化/性别/种族刻板印象

definition: something that helps somebody/something to develop better or more quickly
example: stimulus for something, Books provide children with ideas and a stimulus for play.
definition_zh: 帮助某人或某物更好或更快地发展的事情
example_zh: 书籍为孩子们提供灵感和玩耍的刺激。

definition: to move a liquid or substance around, using a spoon or something similar, in order to mix it completely
example: stir something, She stirred her tea.
definition_zh: 用勺子或类似工具移动液体或物质，使其完全混合
example_zh: 搅动点什么，她搅了搅茶。

definition: the process of keeping something in a particular place until it is needed; the space where things can be kept
example: tables that fold flat for storage
definition_zh: 将某物存放在特定位置直到需要的过程;物品可以存放的空间
example_zh: 可折叠平放以便收纳的桌子

definition: easy to do or to understand; not complicated
example: It's a relatively straightforward process.
definition_zh: 容易操作或理解;不复杂
example_zh: 这是一个相对简单的过程。

definition: pressure on a system or relationship because great demands are being placed on it
example: The transport service cannot cope with the strain of so many additional passengers.
definition_zh: 由于系统或关系承受巨大要求，对其施加了巨大压力
example_zh: 运输服务无法应对如此多额外乘客带来的压力。

definition: a single thin piece of thread, wire, hair, etc.
example: He pulled at a loose strand of wool in his sweater.
definition_zh: 一根细线、铁丝、头发等等。
example_zh: 他扯了扯毛衣里一缕散落的羊毛。

definition: done as part of a plan that is meant to achieve a particular purpose or to gain an advantage
example: strategic planning
definition_zh: 作为实现特定目的或获得优势的计划的一部分而进行的
example_zh: 战略规划

definition: interesting and unusual enough to attract attention
example: a striking feature
definition_zh: 足够有趣且不寻常，足以引起注意
example_zh: 一个引人注目的特点

definition: a long narrow piece of paper, metal, cloth, etc.
example: a strip of material
definition_zh: 一张又长又窄的纸、金属、布料等等。
example_zh: 一条材料条

definition: to take off all or most of your clothes or another person’s clothes
example: I stripped and washed myself all over.
definition_zh: 脱掉你自己或他人的全部或大部分衣服
example_zh: 我脱光衣服，把自己全身都洗干净。

definition: to try very hard to achieve something
example: strive for something, We encourage all members to strive for the highest standards.
definition_zh: 非常努力地去实现某件事
example_zh: 为某事努力，我们鼓励所有会员追求最高标准。

definition: connected with the way in which something is built or organized
example: Storms have caused structural damage to hundreds of homes.
definition_zh: 与某物的建造或组织方式相关
example_zh: 风暴已经对数百座房屋造成结构性损坏。

definition: to hit your foot against something while you are walking or running and almost fall
example: The child stumbled and fell.
definition_zh: 走路或跑步时脚撞到东西，差点摔倒
example_zh: 孩子踉跄跌倒了。

definition: to make a person or an animal unconscious for a short time, especially by hitting them on the head
example: The fall stunned me for a moment.
definition_zh: 让一个人或动物短时间失去意识，尤其是通过敲击其头部
example_zh: 那一瞬间的跌倒让我愣住了。

definition: the act of accepting that somebody has defeated you and that you must obey them
example: a gesture of submission
definition_zh: 接受有人打败了你，并且你必须服从他们的行为
example_zh: 一种顺从的姿态

definition: a person who pays money, usually once a year, to receive regular copies of a magazine or newspaper or have access to it online
example: subscribers to ‘New Scientist’
definition_zh: 一个通常每年支付一次钱，以获得定期杂志或报纸副本或在线访问的人
example_zh: 《新科学家》订阅者

definition: an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a service, be a member of a club, support a charity or receive regular copies of a newspaper or magazine; the act of paying this money
example: an annual subscription
definition_zh: 你定期支付以接受服务、成为俱乐部成员、支持慈善机构或定期获得报纸或杂志的金额;支付这笔钱的行为
example_zh: 年度订阅

definition: money that is paid by a government or an organization to reduce the costs of services or of producing goods so that their prices can be kept low
example: agricultural subsidies
definition_zh: 政府或组织支付的钱，用于降低服务或商品生产成本，从而使其价格保持低位
example_zh: 农业补贴

definition: large in amount, value or importance
example: substantial sums of money
definition_zh: 在数量、价值或重要性上都很大
example_zh: 巨额资金

definition: very much; a lot
example: The costs have increased substantially.
definition_zh: 非常喜欢;非常多
example_zh: 成本大幅增加。

definition: a person or thing that you use or have instead of the one you normally use or have
example: a meat substitute
definition_zh: 一个你用或拥有的人或物，而不是你平时使用或拥有的那个人或物品
example_zh: 肉类替代品

definition: to take the place of somebody/something else; to use somebody/something instead of somebody/something else
example: substitute for somebody/something, Nothing can substitute for the advice your doctor is able to give you.
definition_zh: 取代某人/某物;使用某人/某物代替某人/某物
example_zh: 替代某个人或某物，没有什么能替代医生给你的建议。

definition: an act of using one person or thing in the place of another
example: Two substitutions were made during the game.
definition_zh: 一种用一个人或某物代替另一个人的行为
example_zh: 比赛中做出了两次换人。

definition: not very obvious or easy to notice
example: subtle colours/flavours/smells, etc.
definition_zh: 不太明显，也不容易察觉
example_zh: 细微的颜色/味道/气味等等。

definition: in or connected with a suburb
example: suburban areas
definition_zh: 位于或与郊区相连的
example_zh: 郊区

definition: a number of people or things that follow each other in time or order
example: a succession of visitors
definition_zh: 若干人或事物在时间或顺序上相继而存在
example_zh: 一连串的访客

definition: following immediately one after the other
example: This was their fourth successive win.
definition_zh: 紧接着一个接一个
example_zh: 这是他们连续第四次夺冠。

definition: a person or thing that comes after somebody/something else and takes their/its place
example: Who's the likely successor to him as party leader?
definition_zh: 一个人或事物，追随某个人/某物，取代他们/它的位置
example_zh: 谁最有可能继任他的党魁？

definition: to take liquid, air, etc. into your mouth by using the muscles of your lips
example: to suck the juice from an orange
definition_zh: 用嘴唇肌肉将液体、空气等吸入嘴里
example_zh: 吸橙汁

definition: to make a claim against a person or an organization in court about something that they have said or done to harm you
example: They threatened to sue if the work was not completed.
definition_zh: 在法庭上对某个人或组织提出索赔，指控他们说过或做过伤害你的事
example_zh: 他们威胁说如果工程不完成就要起诉。

definition: the act of killing yourself deliberately
example: to commit suicide
definition_zh: 故意自杀的行为
example_zh: 自杀

definition: a set of rooms, especially in a hotel
example: a hotel/private/honeymoon suite
definition_zh: 一组房间，尤其是在酒店里
example_zh: 酒店/私人/蜜月套房

definition: the highest point of something, especially the top of a mountain
example: We reached the summit at noon.
definition_zh: 某物的最高点，尤其是山顶
example_zh: 我们中午到达了山顶。

definition: excellent; of very good quality
example: a superb player
definition_zh: 优秀;质量非常好
example_zh: 一位出色的球员

definition: better in quality than somebody/something else; greater than somebody/something else
example: vastly superior
definition_zh: 质量优于某人/某物;优于某人/某物
example_zh: 远远优越

definition: to be in charge of somebody/something and make sure that everything is done correctly, safely, etc.
example: supervise (somebody/something), to supervise building work
definition_zh: 负责某人或某事，确保一切都正确、安全地完成。
example_zh: 监督（某人/某物），以监督建筑施工

definition: the work or activity involved in being in charge of somebody/something and making sure that everything is done correctly, safely, etc.
example: Very young children should not be left to play without supervision.
definition_zh: 负责某人或某事的工作或活动，确保一切正确、安全地完成。
example_zh: 年幼的孩子不应被允许在无人看管的情况下玩耍。

definition: a person who supervises somebody/something
example: I have a meeting with my supervisor about my research topic.
definition_zh: 监督某人/某物的人
example_zh: 我要和导师开会，讨论我的研究课题。

definition: a thing that is added to something else to improve or complete it
example: vitamin/dietary supplements (= vitamins and other foods eaten in addition to what you usually eat)
definition_zh: 一个被添加到其他内容上以改进或完成它的东西
example_zh: 维生素/膳食补充剂（= 除了平时吃的外，还摄入的维生素和其他食物）

definition: to add something to something in order to improve it or make it more complete
example: supplement something with something, a diet supplemented with vitamin pills
definition_zh: 为某样东西添加内容，以改善或使其更完整
example_zh: 用某种东西来补充，比如用维生素片补充的饮食

definition: encouraging somebody or giving them help or sympathy
example: a supportive family
definition_zh: 鼓励某人，给予帮助或同情
example_zh: 一个支持我的家庭

definition: according to what is generally thought or believed but not known for certain
example: The novel is supposedly based on a true story.
definition_zh: 根据普遍认为或相信但尚无确切答案的观点
example_zh: 这部小说据说是根据真实故事改编的。

definition: to put an end, often by force, to a group or an activity that is believed to threaten authority
example: The rebellion was brutally suppressed.
definition_zh: 即是通过武力终结被认为威胁权威的团体或活动
example_zh: 叛乱被残酷镇压。

definition: highest in rank or position
example: the Supreme Commander of the armed forces
definition_zh: 军衔或职位最高者
example_zh: 武装部队最高统帅

definition: a sudden increase of a strong feeling
example: She felt a sudden surge of anger.
definition_zh: 一种强烈感觉的突然增强
example_zh: 她突然涌上一股怒火。

definition: to move quickly and with force in a particular direction
example: The gates opened and the crowd surged forward.
definition_zh: 快速且有力地朝特定方向移动
example_zh: 大门打开，人群蜂拥而至。

definition: used in or connected with surgery
example: surgical procedures
definition_zh: 用于或与手术相关的
example_zh: 外科手术

definition: an amount that is extra or more than you need
example: food surpluses
definition_zh: 超出或超过您需求的金额
example_zh: 食品过剩

definition: to admit that you have been defeated and want to stop fighting; to allow yourself to be caught, taken prisoner, etc.
example: The rebel soldiers were forced to surrender.
definition_zh: 承认自己已经被击败，想要停止战斗;允许自己被抓住、俘虏，等等。
example_zh: 叛军士兵被迫投降。

definition: the act of carefully watching a person suspected of a crime or a place where a crime may be committed
example: The police are keeping the suspects under constant surveillance.
definition_zh: 密切监视涉嫌犯罪的人或可能犯罪发生地点的行为
example_zh: 警方对嫌疑人进行持续监视。

definition: the act of officially removing somebody from their job, school, team, etc. for a period of time, usually as a punishment
example: suspension from school
definition_zh: 正式将某人从工作、学校、团队等岗位中撤职一段时间的行为，通常是作为惩罚
example_zh: 停学

definition: a feeling that somebody has done something wrong, illegal or dishonest, even though you have no proof
example: They drove away slowly to avoid arousing suspicion.
definition_zh: 一种感觉，觉得有人做错了事，违法或不诚实，尽管你没有证据
example_zh: 他们缓缓开车离开，以免引起怀疑。

definition: feeling that somebody has done something wrong, illegal or dishonest, without having any proof
example: They became suspicious of his behaviour and contacted the police.
definition_zh: 感觉有人做了错误的事情，非法或不诚实，却没有任何证据
example_zh: 他们对他的行为产生怀疑，于是联系了警方。

definition: to provide enough of what somebody/something needs in order to live or exist
example: Which planets can sustain life?
definition_zh: 提供某人或某物生存或存在所需的足够条件
example_zh: 哪些星球能够维持生命？

definition: a swinging movement or rhythm
example: He took a wild swing at the ball.
definition_zh: 一种摆动的动作或节奏
example_zh: 他猛地挥棒击球。

definition: to move backwards or forwards or from side to side while hanging from a fixed point; to make something do this
example: His arms swung as he walked.
definition_zh: 在悬挂于固定点时向后或向前移动，或左右移动;让某物做到这一点
example_zh: 他走路时手臂不停摆动。

definition: a weapon with a long metal blade (= sharp cutting part) and a handle
example: to draw/sheathe a sword (= to take it out of/put it into its cover)
definition_zh: 一种带有长金属刀刃（=锋利切割部件）和手柄的武器
example_zh: 拔剑/入鞘（= 把剑从剑鞘里拿出来/放进剑鞘）

definition: containing symbols, or being used as a symbol
example: He shook his fist in a symbolic gesture of defiance.
definition_zh: 包含符号，或被用作符号
example_zh: 他挥了挥拳头，象征性地表示反抗。

definition: a set of physical conditions that show you have a particular disease or medical problem
example: PMS or premenstrual syndrome
definition_zh: 一组显示您患有特定疾病或医疗问题的身体状况
example_zh: 经前综合症或经前综合征

definition: the act of combining separate ideas, beliefs, styles, etc.; a mixture or combination of ideas, beliefs, styles, etc.
example: synthesis of A with B, the synthesis of art with everyday life
definition_zh: 将不同思想、信念、风格等结合的行为;思想、信念、风格等的混合或组合。
example_zh: A与B的综合，艺术与日常生活的融合

definition: done according to a system or plan, in a complete, efficient or determined way
example: a systematic approach to solving the problem
definition_zh: 按照系统或计划，以完整、高效或坚定的方式完成
example_zh: 系统化的方法来解决问题

definition: an act of trying to take the ball from an opponent in football (soccer), hockey, etc.; an act of knocking somebody to the ground, for example in rugby or American football
example: He was booked for a late tackle on Torres.
definition_zh: 在足球（足球）、冰球等比赛中试图从对手中抢球的行为;例如在橄榄球或美式橄榄球中，将人击倒在地的行为
example_zh: 他因对托雷斯的一次晚期铲球被黄牌警告。

definition: the particular method you use to achieve something
example: They tried all kinds of tactics to get us to go.
definition_zh: 你用来实现某事的特定方法
example_zh: 他们用了各种手段逼我们走。

definition: connected with the particular method you use to achieve something
example: tactical planning
definition_zh: 与你用来实现某事的具体方法相关
example_zh: 战术规划

definition: a person who pays tax to the government, especially on the money that they earn
example: Hundreds of thousands of pounds of taxpayers' money (= money paid in taxes) have been spent on the project.
definition_zh: 向政府缴税的人，尤其是对自己收入的税款
example_zh: 数十万英镑纳税人的钱（=已缴税款）已用于该项目。

definition: to attract somebody or make somebody want to do or have something, even if they know it is wrong
example: tempt somebody, I was tempted by the dessert menu.
definition_zh: 吸引某人，或者让某人想要做某件事或拥有某样东西，即使他们知道那是错误的
example_zh: 诱惑别人，我被甜点菜单诱惑了。

definition: a person who pays rent for the use of a room, building, land, etc. to the person who owns it
example: They had evicted their tenants for non-payment of rent.
definition_zh: 向房东支付房租，用于使用房间、建筑物、土地等的人
example_zh: 他们因租户未付房租而将其驱逐。

definition: kind, gentle and loving
example: tender words
definition_zh: 善良、温柔且充满爱心
example_zh: 温柔的话语

definition: the period of time when somebody holds an important job, especially a political one; the act of holding an important job
example: his four-year tenure as president
definition_zh: 某人担任重要职位，尤其是政治职位的这段时间;担任重要职位的行为
example_zh: 他担任主席的四年任期

definition: that cannot be cured and will lead to death, often slowly
example: He has terminal lung cancer.
definition_zh: 这种病无法治愈，最终会慢慢走向死亡
example_zh: 他患有晚期肺癌。

definition: to end; to make something end
example: Your contract of employment terminates in December.
definition_zh: 结束;让某件事结束
example_zh: 你的雇佣合同将在十二月到期。

definition: used to refer to an area of land when you are mentioning its natural features, for example, if it is rough, flat, etc.
example: difficult/rough/mountainous terrain
definition_zh: 用来指你提到某片土地的自然特征时，比如它是否崎岖、平坦等。
example_zh: 困难/崎岖/山地地形

definition: excellent; wonderful
example: I feel absolutely terrific today!
definition_zh: 非常好;太棒了
example_zh: 我今天感觉棒极了！

definition: to make a statement that something happened or that something is true, especially as a witness in court
example: testify against somebody/something, She refused to testify against her husband.
definition_zh: 要做出某件事确实发生过或某件事是真的声明，尤其是在法庭上作为证人
example_zh: 她拒绝作证指控某人或某物，却拒绝作证指控她丈夫。

definition: a thing that shows that something else exists or is true
example: This increase in exports bears testimony to the successes of industry.
definition_zh: 一种表明别的事物存在或真实存在的东西
example_zh: 出口的增长证明了工业的成功。

definition: the way a surface, substance or piece of cloth feels when you touch it, for example how rough, smooth, hard or soft it is
example: the soft texture of velvet
definition_zh: 比如你触摸某个表面、物质或布片时的触感，比如它的粗糙、光滑、硬度或柔软程度
example_zh: 天鹅绒的柔软质地

definition: used to show that you are pleased that something good has happened or that something bad has been avoided
example: There was a fire in the building, but thankfully no one was hurt.
definition_zh: 用来表达你为发生了好事或避免了坏事感到高兴
example_zh: 大楼里发生了火灾，但幸好没有人受伤。

definition: connected with the theatre
example: a theatrical agent
definition_zh: 与剧院的关联
example_zh: 一位戏剧经纪人

definition: the study of religion and beliefs
example: a degree in theology
definition_zh: 宗教与信仰的研究
example_zh: 神学学位

definition: connected with the ideas and principles on which a particular subject is based, rather than with practice and experiment
example: a theoretical approach
definition_zh: 与某个特定主题所依据的理念和原则相关，而非实践和实验
example_zh: 理论方法

definition: after the time or event mentioned
example: She married at 17 and gave birth to her first child shortly thereafter.
definition_zh: 在所述时间或事件之后
example_zh: 她17岁时结婚，不久后生下了第一个孩子。

definition: used to introduce the result of the action or situation mentioned
example: Regular exercise strengthens the heart, thereby reducing the risk of heart attack.
definition_zh: 用于介绍所述行为或情境的结果
example_zh: 规律锻炼能增强心脏功能，从而降低心脏病发作的风险。

definition: making people think seriously about a particular subject or issue
example: a brilliant and thought-provoking play
definition_zh: 让人们认真思考某个特定主题或问题
example_zh: 一部精彩且发人深省的戏剧

definition: quiet, because you are thinking
example: He looked thoughtful.
definition_zh: 安静，因为你在思考
example_zh: 他看起来若有所思。

definition: a thin string of cotton, wool, silk, etc. used for sewing or making cloth
example: a needle and thread
definition_zh: 一串细长的棉、羊毛、丝绸等，用于缝纫或制作布料
example_zh: 一根针和一根线

definition: the floor or ground at the bottom of a doorway, considered as the entrance to a building or room
example: He stepped across the threshold.
definition_zh: 门口底部的地板或地面，被视为建筑物或房间的入口
example_zh: 他跨过门槛。

definition: very excited and pleased
example: ‘Are you pleased?’ ‘I'm thrilled.’
definition_zh: 非常兴奋和满意
example_zh: “你满意吗？”“我很激动。”

definition: to become, and continue to be, successful, strong, healthy, etc.
example: New businesses thrive in this area.
definition_zh: 成为并继续成功、坚强、健康等等。
example_zh: 新企业在这一领域蓬勃发展。

definition: a regular rise and fall in the level of the sea, caused by the pull of the moon and sun; the flow of water that happens as the sea rises and falls
example: the ebb and flow of the tide
definition_zh: 海平面规律的升降，由月亮和太阳的拉力引起;海水涨落时发生的水流
example_zh: 潮汐的涨落

definition: to hold or fix something more securely in position; to make something or become more difficult to move, open or separate
example: tighten something, to tighten a lid/screw/rope/knot
definition_zh: 用来更牢固地固定或固定某样东西;使某物变得更难移动、打开或分离
example_zh: 拧紧某样东西，拧紧盖子/螺丝/绳子/结

definition: trees that are grown to be used in building or for making things
example: the timber industry
definition_zh: 用于建筑或制作物品的树木
example_zh: 木材行业

definition: happening at exactly the right time
example: A nasty incident was prevented by the timely arrival of the police.
definition_zh: 恰好在正确的时间发生
example_zh: 警方及时赶到，阻止了一件令人不快的事件发生。

definition: the dried leaves of the tobacco plant that are used for making cigarettes, smoking in a pipe, etc.
example: tobacco smoke
definition_zh: 烟草植物的干叶，用于制烟、吸烟等。
example_zh: 烟草烟雾

definition: the quality of being willing to accept or tolerate somebody/something, especially opinions or behaviour that you may not agree with, or people who are not like you
example: She had no tolerance for jokes of any kind.
definition_zh: 愿意接受或容忍某人或某事的品质，尤其是那些你可能不同意的观点或行为，或者那些与你不同的人
example_zh: 她对任何形式的玩笑都毫无容忍度。

definition: to allow somebody to do something that you do not agree with or like
example: tolerate something, Their relationship was tolerated but not encouraged.
definition_zh: 允许别人做你不同意或不喜欢的事情
example_zh: 容忍点什么，他们的关系被容忍，但并不被鼓励。

definition: money that you pay to use a particular road or bridge
example: motorway tolls
definition_zh: 你为使用某条特定道路或桥梁所支付的费用
example_zh: 高速公路收费

definition: to be higher than a particular amount
example: Worldwide sales look set to top $1 billion.
definition_zh: 高于某一特定金额
example_zh: 全球销售额预计将突破10亿美元。

definition: the act of causing somebody severe pain in order to punish them or make them say or do something
example: Many of the refugees have suffered torture.
definition_zh: 为惩罚某人或迫使他们说话或做某事而施加严重疼痛的行为
example_zh: 许多难民遭受了酷刑。

definition: to hurt somebody physically or mentally in order to punish them or make them tell you something
example: torture somebody, Many of the rebels were captured and tortured by secret police.
definition_zh: 为了惩罚某人或逼他们说出某件事，身体或精神上伤害他们
example_zh: 折磨某人，许多叛乱者被秘密警察抓捕并折磨。

definition: to throw something lightly or carelessly
example: toss something + adv./prep., I tossed the book aside and got up.
definition_zh: 轻轻或随意地扔东西
example_zh: 扔点东西 + 进度/准备，我把书扔到一边，站了起来。

definition: to reach a particular total
example: Imports totalled $1.5 billion last year.
definition_zh: 以达到特定总数
example_zh: 去年进口总额为15亿美元。

definition: containing poison; poisonous
example: toxic chemicals/fumes/gases/substances
definition_zh: 含有毒药;有毒
example_zh: 有毒化学品/烟雾/气体/物质

definition: a mark, an object or a sign that shows that somebody/something existed or was present
example: It's exciting to discover traces of earlier civilizations.
definition_zh: 一个标记、一个物体或一个标志，表明某人/某物曾存在或曾在场
example_zh: 发现早期文明的痕迹令人兴奋。

definition: a name, symbol or design that a company uses for its products and that cannot be used by anyone else
example: ‘Big Mac’ is McDonald's best-known trademark.
definition_zh: 公司用于其产品且不能被他人使用的名称、符号或设计
example_zh: “巨无霸”是麦当劳最著名的标志。

definition: a long line or series of marks that is left by somebody/something
example: a trail of blood
definition_zh: 一长条线或一连串由某人/某物留下的痕迹
example_zh: 一道血迹

definition: to pull something behind somebody/something, usually along the ground; to be pulled along in this way
example: trail something, A jeep trailing a cloud of dust was speeding in my direction.
definition_zh: 拉着某物到某人或某物身后，通常是沿着地面;被这样拉着走
example_zh: 跟踪什么的，一辆吉普车拖着一团尘土朝我飞驰而来。

definition: a truck, or a container with wheels, that is pulled by another vehicle
example: a car towing a trailer with a boat on it
definition_zh: 一辆卡车，或一个带轮子的集装箱，由另一辆车牵引
example_zh: 一辆拖着拖车的汽车，拖着一艘船

definition: a piece of business that is done between people, especially an act of buying or selling
example: financial transactions between companies
definition_zh: 一笔交易，是人与人之间进行的，尤其是买卖的行为
example_zh: 公司间的金融交易

definition: a written or printed copy of words that have been spoken
example: a transcript of the interview
definition_zh: 已说出的文字的书面或印刷副本
example_zh: 采访记录

definition: a complete change in somebody/something
example: The way in which we work has undergone a complete transformation in the past decade.
definition_zh: 某人/某物的彻底转变
example_zh: 在过去十年里，我们的工作方式发生了彻底的转变。

definition: the process of being moved or carried from one place to another
example: The cost includes transit.
definition_zh: 从一个地方搬运或搬运到另一个地方的过程
example_zh: 费用包括交通费用。

definition: the act or process of passing something from one person, place or thing to another
example: the transmission of the disease
definition_zh: 将某物从一个人、一个地方或事物传递给另一个人的行为或过程
example_zh: 疾病的传播

definition: the quality of something, such as a situation or an argument, that makes it easy to understand
example: a need for greater transparency in legal documents
definition_zh: 某件事的质量，比如情境或论点，使其易于理解
example_zh: 法律文件需要更大透明度

definition: allowing you to see through it
example: The insect's wings are almost transparent.
definition_zh: 让你能够透过它看穿它
example_zh: 这种昆虫的翅膀几乎透明。

definition: a mental condition caused by severe shock, stress or fear, especially when the harmful effects last for a long time
example: the effects of trauma and stress on the body
definition_zh: 一种由严重的休克、压力或恐惧引发的精神状况，尤其是当有害影响持续较长时间时
example_zh: 创伤和压力对身体的影响

definition: a formal agreement between two or more countries
example: the Treaty of Rome
definition_zh: 两个或多个国家之间的正式协议
example_zh: 《罗马条约》

definition: very great
example: a tremendous explosion
definition_zh: 非常好
example_zh: 一场巨大的爆炸

definition: connected with a tribe or tribes
example: tribal art
definition_zh: 与某个或多个部落相关的
example_zh: 部落艺术

definition: a type of court with the authority to deal with a particular problem or disagreement
example: an international war crimes tribunal
definition_zh: 一种具有处理特定问题或分歧权力的法院类型
example_zh: 国际战争罪行法庭

definition: an act, a statement or a gift that is intended to show your love or respect, especially for a dead person
example: At her funeral her oldest friend paid tribute to her life and work.
definition_zh: 一种行为、一句话或一份礼物，旨在表达你对逝者的爱或尊重，尤其是对死者的尊重
example_zh: 在她的葬礼上，她最老的朋友向她的一生和作品致敬。

definition: the part of a gun that you press in order to fire it
example: to pull/squeeze the trigger
definition_zh: 枪械中你按压以发射的部分
example_zh: 拉动/扣动扳机

definition: a group of three people or things
example: A trio of English runners featured in the women’s 1 500 metres.
definition_zh: 三个人或三个东西组成的小组
example_zh: 三名英国选手参加了女子1500米比赛。

definition: a great success, achievement or victory
example: one of the greatest triumphs of modern science
definition_zh: 一次巨大的成功、成就或胜利
example_zh: 现代科学的伟大成就之一

definition: an object such as a silver cup that is given as a prize for winning a competition
example: a trophy cabinet
definition_zh: 比如一个作为赢得比赛奖品的银杯这样的物品
example_zh: 一个奖杯柜

definition: worried and anxious
example: She looked into his troubled face.
definition_zh: 既担忧又焦虑
example_zh: 她凝视着他那张忧虑的脸。

definition: a person or an organization that has control of money or property that has been put into a trust for somebody
example: The bank will act as trustees for the estate until the child is 18.
definition_zh: 一个对已为某人设立信托的资金或财产拥有控制权的人或组织
example_zh: 银行将作为遗产的受托人，直到孩子满18岁。

definition: the act of teaching something, especially to one person or to people in small groups
example: She received private tuition in French.
definition_zh: 教某件事的行为，尤其是教一个人或小组中的人
example_zh: 她接受了法语私人辅导。

definition: the number of people who attend a particular event
example: This year's festival attracted a record turnout.
definition_zh: 参加某一特定活动的人数
example_zh: 今年的电影节吸引了创纪录的观众人数。

definition: the total amount of goods or services sold by a company during a particular period of time
example: an annual turnover of $75 million
definition_zh: 公司在特定时期内销售的商品或服务总量
example_zh: 年营业额为7500万美元

definition: the action of turning something with your hand, or of turning a part of your body
example: She gave the lid another twist and it came off.
definition_zh: 用手转动某样东西，或者转动身体某部分的动作
example_zh: 她又拧了转盖子，盖子就脱了。

definition: to bend or turn something into a particular shape
example: Twist the wire to form a circle.
definition_zh: 将某物弯曲或变形成特定形状
example_zh: 把铁丝扭成一个圆。

definition: a university or college student who is studying for their first degree
example: a first-year undergraduate
definition_zh: 正在攻读第一个学位的大学生或学院学生
example_zh: 一名一年级本科生

definition: important in a situation but not always easily noticed or stated clearly
example: The underlying assumption is that the amount of money available is limited.
definition_zh: 在某种情境中很重要，但并不总是容易被注意到或清晰表达
example_zh: 基本假设是可用的资金是有限的。

definition: to make something, especially somebody’s confidence or authority, gradually weaker or less effective
example: Our confidence in the team has been seriously undermined by their recent defeats.
definition_zh: 让某样东西，尤其是某人的自信或权威，逐渐变得脆弱或无效
example_zh: 他们最近的失利严重削弱了我们对球队的信心。

definition: used to emphasize that something exists or is definitely true
example: There is undoubtedly a great deal of truth in what he says.
definition_zh: 用来强调某件事确实存在或绝对真实
example_zh: 他说的话无疑有很大的真实性。

definition: to join people, things, parts of a country, etc. together so that they form a single unit
example: The new leader hopes to unify the country.
definition_zh: 将人、事物、国家的部分等连接在一起，形成一个整体
example_zh: 新领导人希望实现国家统一。

definition: that has never happened, been done or been known before
example: The situation is unprecedented in modern times.
definition_zh: 这从未发生过，也从未被做过，也从未被知晓
example_zh: 这种情况在现代史无前例。

definition: to remove a cover or curtain from a painting, statue, etc. so that it can be seen in public for the first time
example: The Queen unveiled a plaque to mark the official opening of the hospital.
definition_zh: 拆除画作、雕像等的覆盖物或帷幕，使其首次在公众面前可见
example_zh: 女王为医院的正式开业揭幕了一块纪念牌匾。

definition: going to happen soon
example: the upcoming presidential election
definition_zh: 很快就会发生
example_zh: 即将到来的总统选举

definition: the act of making a machine, computer system, etc. more powerful and efficient; the more powerful and efficient machine, computer system, etc.
example: instructions for installing an upgrade to the existing system
definition_zh: 使机器、计算机系统等变得更强大、更高效的行为;更强大、更高效的机器、计算机系统等。
example_zh: 为现有系统安装升级的说明

definition: to make a machine, computer system, etc. more powerful and efficient; to start using a new and better version of a machine, system, etc.
example: upgrade something, We are constantly upgrading our software to meet customers' needs.
definition_zh: 让机器、计算机系统等更强大、更高效;开始使用机器、系统等的新型、更好的版本。
example_zh: 升级某些东西，我们不断升级软件以满足客户需求。

definition: to support something that you think is right and make sure that it continues to exist
example: We have a duty to uphold the law.
definition_zh: 支持你认为正确的事物，并确保它继续存在
example_zh: 我们有责任维护法律。

definition: a service provided for the public, for example an electricity, water or gas supply
example: a privatized electricity utility
definition_zh: 为公众提供的服务，例如电力、水或燃气供应
example_zh: 一家私有化的电力公用事业

definition: to use something, especially for a practical purpose
example: The Romans were the first to utilize concrete as a building material.
definition_zh: 用点东西，尤其是出于实际目的
example_zh: 罗马人是最早使用混凝土作为建筑材料的人。

definition: completely
example: We're so utterly different from each other.
definition_zh: 完全
example_zh: 我们彼此完全不同。

definition: a space that is completely empty of all substances, including all air or other gas
example: a vacuum pump (= one that creates a vacuum)
definition_zh: 一个完全空无一物的空间，包括所有空气或其他气体
example_zh: 真空泵（= 产生真空的泵）

definition: not clear in a person’s mind
example: to have a vague impression/memory/recollection of something
definition_zh: 在一个人心里并不清晰
example_zh: 对某件事有模糊的印象/记忆/回忆

definition: the state of being legally or officially acceptable
example: The period of validity of the agreement has expired.
definition_zh: 法律或官方可接受的状态
example_zh: 协议的有效期已届满。

definition: to disappear suddenly and/or in a way that you cannot explain
example: He turned around and vanished into the house.
definition_zh: 突然消失，或者以一种你无法解释的方式消失
example_zh: 他转身消失在屋里。

definition: often changing; likely to change
example: variable temperatures
definition_zh: 经常变化;很可能改变
example_zh: 可变温度

definition: a situation, number or quantity that can vary or be varied
example: With so many variables, it is difficult to calculate the cost.
definition_zh: 一种可能变化或可变化的情形、数量或数量
example_zh: 由于变量众多，计算成本变得困难。

definition: of many different types
example: varied opinions
definition_zh: 多种类型
example_zh: 各种不同意见

definition: any of the tubes that carry blood from all parts of the body towards the heart
example: the jugular vein
definition_zh: 任何将血液从身体各个部位输送到心脏的管道
example_zh: 颈静脉

definition: a business project or activity, especially one that involves taking risks
example: A disastrous business venture lost him thousands of dollars.
definition_zh: 一个商业项目或活动，尤其是涉及冒险的项目
example_zh: 一次灾难性的商业冒险让他损失了数千美元。

definition: to go somewhere even though you know that it might be dangerous or unpleasant
example: They ventured nervously into the water.
definition_zh: 即使知道可能危险或不愉快，仍要去某个地方
example_zh: 他们紧张地走进水中。

definition: relating to words
example: The job applicant must have good verbal skills.
definition_zh: 与词语相关的
example_zh: 求职者必须具备良好的口语能力。

definition: an official judgement made in court or at an inquest (= an official investigation into somebody's death)
example: Has the jury reached a verdict?
definition_zh: 在法庭或验尸聆讯中作出的正式判决（=对某人死亡的官方调查）
example_zh: 陪审团已经达成裁决了吗？

definition: to check that something is true or accurate
example: verify something, We have no way of verifying his story.
definition_zh: 核查某件事是否真实或准确
example_zh: 核实点什么，我们没法验证他的说法。

definition: writing that is arranged in lines, often with a regular rhythm or pattern of rhyme
example: in verse, Most of the play is written in verse, but some of it is in prose.
definition_zh: 文字按行排列，通常带有规律的节奏或押韵模式
example_zh: 以诗体形式，剧本大部分以诗体形式写成，但部分为散文。

definition: used to show that two teams or sides are against each other
example: It is France versus Brazil in the final.
definition_zh: 用于表示两支队伍或双方彼此对阵
example_zh: 决赛是法国对阵巴西。

definition: a tube that carries blood through the body of a person or an animal, or liquid through the parts of a plant
example: to burst/rupture a blood vessel
definition_zh: 一种将血液输送到人体或动物体内，或液体通过植物各部位的管道
example_zh: 导致血管破裂/破裂

definition: a person who has a lot of experience in a particular area or activity
example: the veteran American actor, Clint Eastwood
definition_zh: 一个在某个特定领域或活动中有丰富经验的人
example_zh: 资深美国演员克林特·伊斯特伍德

definition: that can be done; that will be successful
example: a viable option/proposition
definition_zh: 这是可以做到的;这将取得成功
example_zh: 一个可行的选项/提案

definition: full of life and energy
example: a vibrant city
definition_zh: 充满生命力和活力
example_zh: 一座充满活力的城市

definition: criminal activities that involve sex or drugs
example: At the door were two plain-clothes detectives from the vice squad.
definition_zh: 涉及性或毒品的犯罪活动
example_zh: 门口站着两名便衣侦探，来自风化组。

definition: violent and cruel
example: a vicious attack
definition_zh: 暴力而残忍
example_zh: 一场凶猛的攻击

definition: a person who lives in a village
example: Some of the villagers have lived here all their lives.
definition_zh: 一个住在村庄里的人
example_zh: 有些村民一生都住在这里。

definition: to go against or refuse to obey a law, an agreement, etc.
example: to violate international law
definition_zh: 违背或拒绝遵守法律、协议等。
example_zh: 违反国际法

definition: the act of going against or refusing to obey a law, an agreement, etc.
example: They were in open violation of the treaty.
definition_zh: 违抗或拒绝遵守法律、协议等行为。
example_zh: 他们公然违反了条约。

definition: behaviour or attitudes that show high moral standards
example: He led a life of virtue.
definition_zh: 表现出高道德标准的行为或态度
example_zh: 他过着美德高尚的生活。

definition: connected with the voice
example: vocal music
definition_zh: 与声音连接
example_zh: 声乐

definition: to make a formal and serious promise to do something or a formal statement that is true
example: vow to do something, She vowed never to speak to him again.
definition_zh: 作出正式且严肃的承诺，或作出真实的正式声明
example_zh: 发誓要做点什么，她发誓再也不和他说话。

definition: the fact of being weak and easily hurt physically or emotionally
example: the vulnerability of newborn babies to disease
definition_zh: 那种软弱、容易受到身体或情感伤害的事实
example_zh: 新生儿易感性

definition: weak and easily hurt physically or emotionally
example: These offices are highly vulnerable to terrorist attack.
definition_zh: 虚弱，容易在身体或情感上受伤
example_zh: 这些办公室极易遭受恐怖袭击。

definition: a separate room or area in a hospital for people with the same type of medical condition
example: a maternity/surgical/psychiatric/children’s ward
definition_zh: 医院内为患有相同病症的患者设立的单独房间或区域
example_zh: 产科/外科/精神科/儿童病房

definition: a building where large quantities of goods are stored, especially before they are sent to shops to be sold
example: Police are investigating a fire at a furniture warehouse.
definition_zh: 一座存放大量货物的建筑，尤其是在货物被送到商店出售之前。
example_zh: 警方正在调查一家家具仓库的火灾。

definition: the activity of fighting a war, especially using particular weapons or methods
example: air/naval/guerrilla warfare
definition_zh: 参与战争的活动，尤其是使用特定武器或方法的行为
example_zh: 空中/海军/游击战

definition: a legal document that is signed by a judge and gives the police authority to do something
example: an arrest warrant
definition_zh: 一份由法官签署的法律文件，赋予警方采取行动的权力
example_zh: 逮捕令

definition: to make something necessary or appropriate in a particular situation
example: warrant something, Further investigation is clearly warranted.
definition_zh: 在特定情况下使某项事情变得必要或适当
example_zh: 需要有证据，显然需要进一步调查。

definition: (especially in the past) a person who fights in a battle or war
example: a warrior nation (= whose people are skilled in fighting)
definition_zh: （尤其是过去）参加战斗或战争的人
example_zh: 一个战士民族（=其人民擅长战斗）

definition: to make somebody/something less strong or powerful; to become less strong or powerful
example: The team has been weakened by injury.
definition_zh: 使某人或某物变得不那么强壮或有力；变得不那么强壮或有力
example_zh: 球队因伤病而实力减弱。

definition: to make cloth, a carpet, a basket, etc. by crossing threads or narrow pieces of material across, over and under each other by hand or on a machine called a loom
example: weave A from B, The baskets are woven from strips of willow.
definition_zh: 通过手工或使用一种称为织机的机器，将线或细长的材料交叉、上下交叉，来制作布料、地毯、篮子等
example_zh: 从A编织到B，篮子是用柳条编织而成。

definition: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted, especially among crops or garden plants
example: The yard was overgrown with weeds.
definition_zh: 一种野生植物生长在不受欢迎的地方，尤其是在农作物或园艺植物之间
example_zh: 院子里杂草丛生。

definition: a deep hole in the ground from which people obtain water. The sides of wells are usually covered with brick or stone and there is usually a cover or a small wall at the top of the well.
example: to dig/sink a well
definition_zh: 一个深坑，人们从中取水。井的侧壁通常覆盖砖或石头，井顶通常有盖板或小墙。
example_zh: 挖/挖井

definition: general health and happiness
example: emotional/physical/psychological well-being
definition_zh: 整体健康与幸福
example_zh: 情感/身体/心理健康

definition: not at all; not of any kind
example: They received no help whatever.
definition_zh: 一点也不;一点也不
example_zh: 他们完全没有得到任何帮助。

definition: not at all; not of any kind
example: They received no help whatsoever.
definition_zh: 一点也不;一点也不
example_zh: 他们完全没有得到任何帮助。

definition: by which; because of which
example: They have introduced a new system whereby all employees must undergo regular training.
definition_zh: 由此;因为
example_zh: 他们引入了一套新制度，要求所有员工定期接受培训。

definition: during the time that something is happening; at the same time as something else is happening
example: In the UK it is illegal to drive whilst holding a mobile phone.
definition_zh: 在某件事正在发生的那段时间;同时发生其他事情
example_zh: 在英国，手持手机驾驶是违法的。

definition: to hit a person or an animal hard with a whip, as a punishment or to make them go faster or work harder
example: He was taken back to the jail and soundly whipped.
definition_zh: 用鞭子狠狠打人或动物，作为惩罚，或者让他们跑得更快或更努力
example_zh: 他被带回监狱，挨了一顿严厉的鞭打。

definition: completely
example: wholly inappropriate behaviour
definition_zh: 完全
example_zh: 完全不合适的行为

definition: to become wider; to make something wider
example: Her eyes widened in surprise.
definition_zh: 变得更宽广;去创造更广阔的东西
example_zh: 她的眼睛惊讶地睁大了。

definition: a woman whose husband or wife has died and who has not married again
example: She gets a widow’s pension.
definition_zh: 一位丈夫或妻子去世且未再婚的女性
example_zh: 她领取寡妇养老金。

definition: the measurement from one side of something to the other; how wide something is
example: The terrace runs the full width of the house.
definition_zh: 物体一侧到另一侧的尺寸;物体的宽度
example_zh: 露台贯穿整栋房子的宽度。

definition: the quality of being happy and ready to do something
example: Success in studying depends on a willingness to learn.
definition_zh: 快乐、准备好做点什么的品质
example_zh: 学习的成功取决于学习意愿。

definition: to rub something against a surface, in order to remove dirt or liquid from it; to rub a surface with a cloth, etc. in order to clean it
example: wipe something (on something), Please wipe your feet on the mat.
definition_zh: 用某物摩擦表面，以去除污垢或液体;用布擦拭表面等以清洁
example_zh: 擦点东西（在某处），请把脚擦在垫子上。

definition: the ability to say or write things that are both clever and humorous
example: to have a quick/sharp/dry/ready wit
definition_zh: 能够说或写出既聪明又幽默的话
example_zh: 要有敏捷/敏锐/干练/机智

definition: the act of taking an amount of money out of your bank account
example: You can make withdrawals of up to $250 a day.
definition_zh: 从你的银行账户中取出一笔钱的行为
example_zh: 你每天最多可以提取250美元。

definition: a period of physical exercise that you do to keep fit
example: She does a 20-minute workout every morning.
definition_zh: 一段为保持体能而进行的身体锻炼期
example_zh: 她每天早上做20分钟的锻炼。

definition: the practice of showing respect for God or a god, by saying prayers, singing with others, etc.; a ceremony for this
example: an act/a place of worship
definition_zh: 通过祈祷、与他人合唱等方式表达对上帝或神的尊敬;为此举行的仪式
example_zh: 一个行为/礼拜场所

definition: to show respect for God or a god, especially by saying prayers, singing, etc. with other people in a religious building
example: The Mayans built jungle pyramids to worship their gods.
definition_zh: 表达对上帝或神的尊敬，尤其是在宗教建筑中与他人一起祈祷、唱歌等
example_zh: 玛雅人建造了丛林金字塔来祭拜他们的神明。

definition: important, pleasant, interesting, etc.; worth spending time, money or effort on
example: It was in aid of a worthwhile cause (= a charity, etc.).
definition_zh: 重要、愉快、有趣等;值得投入时间、金钱或精力
example_zh: 它支持的是有意义的事业（=慈善机构等）。

definition: having the qualities that deserve somebody/something
example: Very few of his ideas are worthy of further attention.
definition_zh: 拥有值得某人或某物的品质
example_zh: 他的观点中很少值得进一步关注。

definition: to shout loudly, for example because you are angry, excited, frightened or in pain
example: yell (at somebody/something), He yelled at the other driver.
definition_zh: 比如因为你生气、兴奋、害怕或疼痛而大声喊叫
example_zh: 对着某人/某物大喊，他对另一位司机大喊。

definition: the total amount of crops, profits, etc. that are produced
example: a high crop yield
definition_zh: 作物总量、利润等生产量
example_zh: 高产量

definition: to produce or provide crops, profits, results or other things
example: The investment yielded significant profits.
definition_zh: 生产或提供作物、利润、成果或其他事物
example_zh: 这项投资带来了可观的利润。

definition: a young person or a child
example: The camp is for youngsters aged 8 to 14.
definition_zh: 一个年轻人或一个孩子
example_zh: 该营面向8至14岁的青少年。
